claim: Z.ai published its first Responsible Scaling Policy in June 2025, defining capability thresholds for CBRN and cyber risks.

source.excerpt: Z.ai's Responsible Scaling Policy defines capability thresholds for CBRN and cyber risks. We commit to apply enhanced mitigations when models cross these thresholds.

provenance.context: Z.ai Responsible Scaling Policy v1 (June 2025). URL: https://z.ai/policies/responsible-scaling-policy-v1.pdf

claim: Z.ai submitted a Winter 2025 FLI Index survey response, providing additional transparency on its RSP implementation.

source.excerpt: Z.ai submitted a response to the FLI Winter 2025 survey.

provenance.context: FLI AI Safety Index Winter 2025 Appendix A. URL: https://futureoflife.org/wp-content/uploads/2025/12/AI-Safety-Index-Report_131225_Full_Report_Digital.pdf

claim: Z.ai's GLM-4.5 system card (Aug 2025) reported 'medium' capability for CBRN uplift studies, below the RSP threshold.

source.excerpt: We assess GLM-4.5 as medium capability for CBRN uplift. This is below the RSP threshold for enhanced mitigations.

provenance.context: Z.ai GLM-4.5 System Card (Aug 2025). URL: https://z.ai/models/glm-4-5/system-card
